summary: Klamath County summit where the Klamath Forest Protective Association stationed a lookout in 1931 for one season; a predecessor of Parker Mountain.

events.note: The Klamath County Fire Lookouts blog dates construction to 1931 and lists the structures as unknown; a KFPA annual report cited for 1930 describes a road built to the summit
A June 1931 Evening Herald report, quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, says a regular lookout was stationed on the peak; the blog says it was staffed for only one season

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1931 newspaper quoted on the Forest Lookouts page calls the peak Grizzly Peak; the other listings call it Grizzly Mountain. The Forest Lookouts page places the quote under this Klamath County entry, and the blog gives the same section (Sec 31 T40S R5E), so it is treated as the same site.
A 1930 KFPA annual report describes the road to the summit; the blog and the June 1931 newspaper date the lookout itself to 1931.

sources.title: Grizzly Mountain in Klamath County OR (Parker Mountain Area)

notes_for_editor: This is the Klamath County site (Sec 31 T40S R5E, KFPA). It is not the Curry County NHLR Grizzly Mountain (us-or-grizzly-mountain), which must not be merged with it. The record coordinates match MountainZone's point (42.0401414, -122.2875177) to four decimals, so no location correction. The county and status are as the record has them; status stays unknown because no source says whether anything stood after the one-season staffing. The Klamath blog citation is its home page (no per-entry URL was found). The entry is not in the firelookout.org Oregon list, so no FFLOS status. No photos found. Dating of 1931 is medium confidence (two independent-looking sources, one quoting a KFPA report); fate and today's site are unknown. Two web searches used.
